### Do Exactly What God Tells You to Do - Daily Hope with Rick Warren - February 1, 2025
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-february-1-2025.html
Passage: Genesis 7:5
Points:
- Noah did not merely listen to God's word; he actively aligned his life to it.
- Building an ark and expecting rain required massive faith in unfamiliar commands.
- God supernaturally gathered the animals, but Noah was responsible for radical obedience.
- Trusting God means avoiding tempting shortcuts and waiting patiently on His timing.

### Come Into the Ark - Love Worth Finding - June 16
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-june-16-devotional.html
Passage: Genesis 7:1
Points:
- To escape divine wrath, a person must step aboard God's vessel of grace.
- God extended the invitation, but Noah still had to take the step of faith to enter.
- The physical ark serves as a clear prophetic picture of salvation in Jesus Christ.
- Believers find eternal safety by coming to Christ just as they are.

### The Heavens Open
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/heavens-open
Passage: Genesis 7:11-16
Points:
- The bursting deep and opened skies deliberately echo the watery chaos before creation.
- God returned the corrupted world to water so He could begin anew with Noah.
- Unlike ancient pagan myths, Scripture reveals God subduing and unleashing waters without opposition.
- The Lord's absolute power over floods demonstrates that He alone can judge and save.

### Bible Pathways - Jan. 3, 2007
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-jan-3-2007-1461324.html
Passage: Genesis 7:1
Points:
- Noah proved his faith by building the ark and preaching righteousness to his generation.
- The ark represents Christ, who offers true refuge from spiritual death to all who come to Him.
- When the Lord shut the door, it demonstrated divine protection as well as an end to opportunity.
- Because judgment arrives unexpectedly, believers are urged to enter God's rest without delay.
